source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eight Pacifica Playground rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Source-defined meals and prices are retained as local offerings; no generic catalogue assortment is inferred. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only.

entities.name: Cubeland by the Sea
entities.source_summary: Low-cost cube hotel near Playland by the Sea, used by park workers and enthusiasts as lodging.

entities.name: Mister Rice Guy
entities.source_summary: Restaurant with two source-defined meal tiers: an inexpensive Kibble-based option flavored in South and East Asian styles, and a premium meal using real fish, rice and vegetables.

local_offerings.label: Pink real-fish, rice and vegetable meal

entities.name: Pacifica Arcology Ruins
entities.source_summary: Dangerous sealed ruins associated with scavenging and unexplained hazards rather than an established commercial operation.

entities.name: Playhouse
entities.source_summary: Apartment complex with source-explicit rental agreements and fees, making it a housing service rather than passive residential context.

entities.name: Quaid Winston Memorial De-Salinization Plant
entities.source_summary: Operational water-treatment infrastructure supplying Playland by the Sea; the source does not establish a public retail water business at the plant.

entities.name: ShellShock Central
entities.source_summary: Major roller-derby track and home of the Sea Shells; attendance receipts also qualify visitors for a Playland ticket discount.

benefits.label: 5% Playland ticket discount with attendance receipt

entities.name: Scenic Cubes
entities.source_summary: Graffiti-covered cube hotel functioning as lodging and a social residential space; no separate drinks business is established.

entities.name: Torta-sienda
entities.source_summary: Small family-run eatery using fresh ingredients supplied through Jodes and minimizing SCOP; a source-defined family hand sign can earn customers a discount.
entities.pricing_note: A source-defined family hand sign can qualify a customer for a discount; no exact discount value is stated.
